Population increased in Hyndburn

The estimated population of Hyndburn in 2024 was 86,058 usual residents, a rise of 1.5% since 2023.

This meant that Hyndburn's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Hyndburn increased by 4.6%.

Over this slightly longer period, Hyndburn was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Hyndburn

The average (median) age fell to 39 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Hyndburn has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Hyndburn is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Hyndburn's population of 86,058 usual residents was made up of:

  • 17,257 people aged 0 to 15 years, (20.1%)
  • 53,313 people aged 16 to 64 years, (62%)
  • 15,488 people aged 65 years and over, (18%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Hyndburn has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (20.1% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Hyndburn, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Hyndburn
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Hyndburn, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 41 people (0%). In total, there were 951 births and 992 deaths in Hyndburn.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 436 (0.5%). There were 5,179 people entering the area and 4,743 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Hyndburn's population of 906 (1.1%) as a result of 1,100 people entering the area and 194 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Hyndburn was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Hyndburn in mid-2023 is 84,747.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 495 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 9 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 486 people.
